sub_answers.text: Sanjjana (Archana Manohar Galrani) is an Indian model and actress who predominantly works in Kannada and Telugu films.[d19540993s0p0] She made her film debut in the 2005 Telugu film Soggadu.[d19540993s0p0] She is known for her role in the Kannada film Ganda Hendathi (2006).[d19540993s0p0] In 2017, she played Chandri in the Kannada crime drama Dandupalya 2.[d19540993s0p0] In 2025, she participated in the Telugu reality show Bigg Boss 9 and finished as 4th runner-up.[d19540993s0p0]
